task_card.title: TTS in Vision: resolve Qwen3-TTS viability, then wire Chatterbox + Qwen as Flows

next_action.description: Implement the remote-twin fix Fabio approved: in routes/remoteModels.js:225 narrow `if (dep.targetPath) return true;` to `if (dep.targetPath && dep.bakedOnPod) return true;`, and add `bakedOnPod: true` to the rife47 entry in js/data/modelConstants/assetDeps.js. Rationale, all verified: rife47 IS baked (cubric-vision-pod/Dockerfile:376) but carries only the blanket rule; chatterbox appears NOWHERE in c:/AI/Mpi/mpi-ci (no node pack, no weights, neither image); bakedOnPod already exists on 7 engineAsset weights. targetPath = WHERE ON DISK, bakedOnPod = WHETHER THE POD HAS IT - conflating them is the defect. Chatterbox then reports not-installed on remote, which fails CLOSED. Do NOT bake chatterbox into the Pod image. Then resolve the blocked push with Fabio.

key_decisions: ComfyUI-MpiNodes is NOT in requiredDeps, and Flow B must not declare it either. `requiredDeps` means nodes/weights NO MODEL requires; every model declares MpiNodes; and a flow's deps are protected UNCONDITIONALLY in _localSharedDepsMap (a flow is always 'present', unlike a model), so naming a registry-wide dep pinned it for every uninstall and broke MPI-258 B1. It installs anyway - getUniversalWorkflowDepIds() returns EVERY type:'custom_nodes' dep and the boot gate installs that whole set regardless of any model or flow.
REMOTE: do NOT bake chatterbox into the Pod image. Stop the lie instead (see next_action). Fabio approved this.

The FlowDef deliberately declares NO preview/video. The tile guards on flow.preview so it renders no thumb rather than a broken image - and a flow naming art that does not exist is exactly what kept CI red for a day (MPI-567's flow-scribble-object.webp 404 in the desktop suite).

No fields, no steps, no result.compare: seed comes from _buildParams via the Input_Seed MpiInt convention, use_cpu/keep_model_loaded are engine plumbing, and a reveal bar between two waveforms says nothing.
The four user-guidance rules are copy, not configuration: perform but do not push / pick a target that sounds nothing like you / meet its pitch / hold that pitch steady.
constraints: PUSH IS BLOCKED AND NEEDS FABIO'S DECISION. Commit d8f9f782 is LOCAL ONLY. The new .husky/pre-push hook (b1ca2984) refuses a push while master's last CI run is failing; master is red on MPI-567's flow-scribble-object.webp 404. The fix for that red IS in the local stack (d7ca048f + 1048c0dd, both unpushed), so `git push --no-verify` is legitimate per the hook's own message - but the permission classifier DENIED it. Do not work around it; ask Fabio.

THE targetPath BUG, both halves, because it will bite any future targetPath dep: (1) _localModelsCheck (routes/comfy.js) duplicated path resolution and omitted the targetPath branch resolveComfyPath has, so it searched the models root - the one place such a weight can never be; (2) syncModelInstalled (js/data/modelRegistry.js) projected deps to {id,type,filename} and DROPPED targetPath, so half 1 fired for nobody. Either half alone reports a downloaded weight missing forever: badge never flips, install bar sticks at 100% with Cancel showing, and a restart cannot help because the answer is deterministic.

METHOD LESSON worth more than the bug: VERIFYING A ROUTE WITH A HAND-BUILT PAYLOAD PROVES NOTHING ABOUT THE CALLER. The first fix verified green against full dep objects and shipped a still-broken app, because the app sends a stripped projection. Reproduce the caller's payload.

THE WEIGHTS MUST STAY targetPath. The pack computes <ComfyUI>/models/chatterbox/ from its own __file__ and never reads extra_model_paths.yaml, so a weight filed under mpi_models/ is simply absent and hf_hub_download refetches 4.25GB outside the download manager. Same class as RIFE (MPI-222).

PEER SESSIONS ARE LIVE IN THIS TREE. MPI-567 renamed its flow to 'Draw It In' and made its art mid-session; MPI-608 is also active. Uncommitted files NOT mine and deliberately left: comfy_workflows/raw/{krea2_t2i,ltx_i2v_t2v,sdxl_t2i}_template.json and dev_configs/smoke-run.txt. Commit by explicit pathspec only.

sync-raw-workflows.mjs REFUSES to run while any generated workflow is uncommitted (it rebuilds all templates). flow_voice_changer.json is a BARE name so it routes straight to a runtime file with no orchestrate step - it was written from the same converter stdout the sync writes verbatim, then passed validate-injection-rules.mjs.
Bench output does NOT land in <ComfyUI>/output - it is redirected to D:\WORK\Images\Outputs\. The flow's proof clip is D:\WORK\Images\Outputs\audio\MPI607_VC_flowtest_00001.flac.
